description: This incredible apartment has a true Parisian style. Hardwood floors, framed mirrors, high ceilings, and marble fireplaces give this apartment the atmosphere of an old-world mansion. Plush bedrooms, decorated with antique wallpaper and generous pillows, will lull you to sleep. Steps from the Avenue Des Champs-Elysées, this three-bedroom apartment is as sophisticated as its surroundings. Many classic sites, such as the Arc de Triomphe and the Grand Palais, can be reached easily on foot.The space160 sqm1st bedroom (1 double bed) 2nd bedroom (1 double bed)3rd bedroom (2 single beds)1st bathroom (shower/toilet)2nd bathroom (shower only)1 separated toiletFinest linens and towelsHigh end toiletriesFully equipped kitchenNespresso machine with capsulesOther things to noteTo ensure a smooth and secure arrival, you will need to complete a brief online check-in process before your stay. It's quick, easy, and helps us prepare for your visit!
